cases.name: Lindsey Baum
cases.about: On the "Justice for Lindsey Baum" Facebook page an entry written by her mother wrote on 6/26/2021 said she had just completed the 5th grade and was bright, sunny, highly intelligent and a very smart child who loved singing in the shower and wanted to become a veterinarian and a children's book author.
cases.narrative: In the 9/2017, her body was found by a group of hunters deep in a woods in Ellensburg, Washington, 85 miles east of Seattle.
